info.name: Auction API
info.description: Import this collection and Auction API Local.postman_environment.json. baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:3000. Only GET /health and the starter GET / are implemented. All domain paths, DTOs, and permitted operations are proposals based on schema.prisma, not existing API behavior. No authentication is configured. Run the Health folder for current validation; planned requests will return 404. UUID variables are illustrative, not seeded records. Replace foreign keys consistently and use a fresh idempotencyKey per logical creation. Decimal money values use strings to preserve precision; timestamps use ISO 8601 UTC. Generated IDs and timestamps are omitted from create bodies. Prisma relations use Restrict deletes, so future CRUD may reject records with dependencies. Append-only/read-only choices are proposed business constraints, not enforced by the current API.
